mm.intro:
BROTHER FOREVER.

He was part of our history, our road and our brotherhood. Time does not erase true friendship, and distance does not cancel trust. We remember the road we rode together and keep his name in the history of Wolves Brotherhood MC.
mm.empty: This section has been prepared in memory of our brothers. Cards are published only with the approval of the club and the family.
mm.notFound: This memorial card was not found or is no longer published.
mm.preview: Preview — this card is not published ({status}). Only editors can see it.

pa.peopleText: Member profiles are visible to club members only, and each field only to the roles allowed to see it. Add only club-approved information. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
pa.accountHint: Linking lets brothers message him directly (Comms) and lets the member see his own profile in full.
pa.accountNoPerm: Accounts can be linked by a role with the “Accounts: view” permission.
pa.noProfiles: No profiles yet. Add the first one with “Add a brother”.
pa.rankManual: Rank and status never change automatically — only through this manual action, and every change is recorded in the audit log (before/after).
pa.photoConsent: Upload a photo only with the member's own consent.
pa.factsOnly: Write only verified, club-approved facts — do not invent or embellish.
pa.visOverrideText: By default the global settings apply (“Field visibility”). Here you can change them for this profile only, e.g. hide the phone number at the member's request.
pa.visNeedA: Visibility is changed by a role with the “Member profiles: approve” permission.
pa.visText: For each field, set the lowest role that can see it. Profile editors and the member himself (if the profile is linked to his account) see all fields. Checked on the server.
pa.visAlways: Visible to everyone with access to the Brothers section
pa.visEditorsNote: Role levels and the “Member profiles: view” permission are set in “Roles and permissions”.
pa.rankConfirmText: The change will be recorded in the audit log under your name.
pa.archiveText: The profile will no longer be shown in the Brothers section. Nothing is deleted and the profile can be restored.
pa.listsText: The club defines its own lists of ranks, positions and membership statuses. The order here is the order on the Brothers page (highest first). IDs do not change after saving.
pa.defaultList: Default — to be confirmed by the club
pa.memText: Memorial cards. Only published cards are public; drafts and cards under review are visible to editors only.
pa.rule1: Never invent merits, club status, life facts or circumstances of death. Write only verified information.
pa.rule2: Only a role with “Memorials: approve” may publish, and only once family or legal representative consent is recorded together with who gave it.
pa.rule3: Using the photo requires the same consent. The photo becomes public only when the card is published.
pa.rule4: A published card can only be edited by an approver. Every action is recorded in the audit log.
pa.publishConfirm: Confirm that all information on the card has been verified and that consent to publish it and use the photo was given by: {who}.
pa.unpublishConfirm: The card and its photo will no longer be public. The card becomes a draft.
pa.editPublished: This card is published — changes will be public immediately.
pa.lockedPublished: This card is published. It can only be edited by a role with “Memorials: approve”.
pa.nameHint: Enter a name or a club name (at least one).
pa.textHint: The editorial base text is prefilled. You can extend it for this card.
pa.consentFamily: The family or legal representative has consented to publishing this card and using the photo
pa.consentByPh: Name and relation, e.g. brother / wife / legal representative
pa.consentNotePh: How and when consent was given, photo source and author
pa.slugHint: Used in the link memorials.html#m-… Changing it breaks the old link.
pa.noMemorials: No cards yet. Create a card as a draft, verify the facts and the family's consent, then publish.
pa.wordsText: Words of remembrance left by members. Public only after approval; the author's name only if the author allowed it.
err.consent_required: Before publishing, record the family or legal representative consent and who gave it.
err.approver_required: Record who approved the card (family or legal representative).
err.consent_published: Unpublish the card first, then withdraw consent.
err.name_required: Enter a name or a club name.
